description: Example of the 3-slide video clip pattern

example_slides.comment: SLIDE 1: Question only - shows the question text
example_slides.questionText: Name the TV/Movie from the clip

example_slides.comment: SLIDE 2: Video only - fullscreen video playback with NO controls
SLIDE 3: Question with countdown timer - shows question again with 30sec timer
example_slides.questionText: Name the TV/Movie from the clip

example_slides.comment: Answer slide - references the timer slide
example_slides.title: Answer

notes: 1. Slide 1 (video-clip): Shows only the question - no video, no timer
2. Slide 2 (video-fullscreen): Shows only the video - fullscreen, no controls, no question
3. Slide 3 (video-clip-timer): Shows only the question with countdown - no video
To use this in your quiz, replace the current Round 3 'question-video' slides
with this 3-slide pattern for each video question.
